34:2: “Instruct Bnei Yisroel and say to them:
‘When you come to the land of Canaan,
this is the land which will be divided for you as hereditary property,
the land of Canaan according to its borders.
34:3: Your southern flank shall be from the Tzin wilderness along the borders of Edom;
from the edge of the Salt Sea to the east.
34:4: The border then turns south of the heights of Akrabim passing toward Tzin;
and then it shall extend to Chatzar Adar and continue toward Atzmon.
34:8: and the outskirts of the border shall be toward Tzedad.

35:12: These cities shall serve you as a refuge from the blood avenger,
so that the murderer will not die
until he stands in judgment before the congregation.
35:17: Or if with a stone that can be taken in the hand and which has the ability to kill he strikes him, and he died, he is a murderer;
35:18: Or if with a wooden implement [that can be] taken in the hand and which has the ability to cause death he strikes him, and he died, he is a murderer;
35:19: when he has been proven guilty by law he may kill him.
35:23: Or (even) with a stone which has the ability to kill, without seeing [the victim],

but he was not his enemy
and did not seek his harm.
35:31: And do not accept monetary compensation for the life of a murderer
who is wicked to incur the death penalty,
35:33: Do not incur guilt on the land in which you live,
and for the land there can be no atonement for the innocent blood that was spilled in it,
except through the blood of the one who spilled it.
35:34: You must not defile the land in which you live,
36:2: to give the land as an inheritance, through the casting of lots, to Bnei Yisroel,
and our master was commanded by the Word of Adonoy
to give the inheritance of our brother Tzelofchad to his daughters.
36:3: But if they marry a member of another tribe of Bnei Yisroel,
their inheritance will be subtracted from our father’s inheritance,
and it will be added to the inheritance of the tribe
and from the lot of our inheritance it will be subtracted.
36:11: And they were — Machlah, Sirtzah, Choglah, Milkah and No’ah, the daughters of Tzelofchad —
